questions.question: What is the $k$-th order Taylor polynomial of $f$ at $x = a$?
questions.explanation: The $k$-th order Taylor polynomial at $a$ is $P_k(x)=f(a)+f'(a)(x-a)+\cdots+\frac{f^{(k)}(a)}{k!}(x-a)^k$.
